description: Update a smart folder (filtered view) by its slug. Provide only the fields to change: 'name', 'description', 'base_query' (the filter query), and/or 'triage_buckets' (the tabs/stages). Use list_smart_folders to find the slug.

action.description: Optional action applied when moving a post into this tab.

filter.description: Filter query that defines the tab's posts.

name.description: Tab/stage name shown inside the folder.

name: update_smart_folder
